gt_provenance.details: Uses belief_core gold continuation labels (follow_belief.jsonl and believe_truth.jsonl) for task evaluation; world_knowledge (reality.jsonl) for Fisher knowledge signal. No model-generated references. Same GT provenance as main experiment. Fisher computed from log P(y+|x) gradients where y+ is the dataset-provided gold continuation.

score_normalization.details: Fisher computed as absolute squared gradients (empirical Fisher, no normalization by model statistics). Head candidate scores = AND-NOT mask fraction (target-AND-NOT-knowledge parameters per head). Target accuracy drop = acc_clean - acc_ablated (raw difference, no normalization). PPL criterion uses ablated_ppl / clean_ppl ratio. All consistent with main experiment.
